result:
The proposed answer of d − 1 is wrong.

The morphism space between two supersingular rank-2 Drinfeld modules is a rank-4 module over A = F_q[T], so it is infinite-dimensional over F_q. The multiplication by T has τ-degree 2, so the dimension of the τ-degree ≤ s part grows linearly in s, roughly like 2s. It cannot be a constant independent of s.

A check with d = 1 confirms this. Take 𝔭 = T and φ_T = τ². The endomorphisms are all of F_{q²}[τ]. Those of τ-degree at most s form a space of F_q-dimension 2(s+1), which grows with s. The proposed formula gives 0 here.

I did not derive the exact formula. The d = 1 case and the linear growth suggest something of the form 2s + 3 − d, but that is a guess.

VERDICT: REJECT
